items.subject: authenticated target wallet and keystore responses
items.reason: The baseline has bundle-extracted candidate paths but no authenticated, redacted wallet CRUD, keystore, reset, or transfer response fixtures.
items.requiredFollowUp: Capture approved authenticated request/response fixtures with secrets removed, compare them to the local adapter contract, and retain evidence classification until matched.

items.subject: target custody cryptographic internals
items.reason: The target bundle does not establish its cipher, KDF, AAD, DEK, KEK, rotation, memory, or disaster recovery design.
items.requiredFollowUp: Keep the frozen design labeled LOCAL-DECISION unless authoritative target documentation or audited server evidence becomes available.

items.subject: complete target /wallets and /settings state coverage
items.reason: No authenticated desktop/mobile golden set covers locked, conflict, reset, transfer lineage, custom RPC error, and OKX failure states.
items.requiredFollowUp: Capture and redact approved target states before any visual parity claim.

items.subject: independent custody and signer security review
items.reason: P04-01 freezes contracts only and is not an independent review of a signer implementation.
items.requiredFollowUp: Complete design and implementation reviews, close findings, and approve testnet use before enabling any decryption or signing path.

items.subject: locked memory and zeroization implementation evidence
items.reason: No signer runtime exists, so mlock, core-dump controls, short-lived process isolation, buffer-copy accounting, and crash cleanup are unverified.
items.requiredFollowUp: Implement the isolated signer boundary and exercise success, failure, timeout, crash, and auto-lock memory cleanup under an approved review plan.

items.subject: KMS backup, rotation, and disaster recovery drill
items.reason: The lifecycle fixture is a state-machine fixture and does not contact KMS, restore ciphertext, or open an envelope.
items.requiredFollowUp: Run an isolated two-person restore drill with synthetic wallets, versioned KMS backups, no broadcast egress, and an auditable rollback.

items.subject: production Argon2id parameter calibration
items.reason: Version 1 parameters are frozen as a minimum design input but have not been benchmarked on the future signer hardware or under concurrency limits.
items.requiredFollowUp: Benchmark the production parameter set on signer hardware, record latency and memory ceilings, and publish a reviewed parameter version without weakening the frozen minimum.

items.subject: native and ERC-20 transfer reconciliation
items.reason: P04-01 does not sign, broadcast, access RPC, obtain a receipt, or reconcile a real balance or Token Transfer event.
items.requiredFollowUp: After security approval, run synthetic Anvil/fork transactions covering success, revert, dropped, replacement, reorg, gas, balance, nonce, and event reconciliation.

items.subject: browser-only custom RPC behavior
items.reason: No browser RPC request is made and provider timeout, CORS, redirect, chain mismatch, response size, and rate-limit behavior remain unverified.
items.requiredFollowUp: Implement the allowlist in the browser and verify it against local synthetic JSON-RPC fixtures before any approved external provider test.

items.subject: OKX key validation and egress
items.reason: No OKX credential is stored or opened and no OKX request is made; permissions, rotation, revocation, and provider failures are contract-only.
items.requiredFollowUp: Implement a dedicated connector with synthetic local provider fixtures, then use an approved read-only sandbox credential for a separately reviewed staging test.
